服务实例ID。

您可以通过调用[ListServiceInstances - 查询服务实例列表](~~396200~~)获取服务实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the service instance.

Call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to obtain the service instance ID.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Before you call this operation, ensure that the service provider enabled the upgrade and downgrade feature and configured its parameters when the service was created.
